report.summary: Approximately 8% of UPI payments began failing at 14:07 on 2026-10-07 due to an incorrect routing configuration update on upi-gateway. The configuration change (chg-9824) shifted @okbank handles to partner-bank-api /v3/collect, which resulted in HTTP 404 Not Found errors from partner-bank-api and subsequent U30 route failure errors in payments-api.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Routing Configuration Update on upi-gateway Introduced Invalid Endpoint Path for @okbank

supporting.note: Configuration change updating @okbank handles to partner-bank-api /v3/collect occurred at 14:06, immediately preceding the anomaly.
payments-api error rate rose sharply starting at 14:07.
upi-gateway error rate rose sharply starting at 14:07.
upi-gateway logs show partner-bank-api returning 404 Not Found for POST /v3/collect starting at 14:07.
payments-api logs report failures due to upi-gateway error U30 (route failure) starting at 14:07.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Concurrent payments-api Deployment (v2.15.0) Caused Routing Incompatibilities

supporting.note: payments-api v2.15.0 deployed at 14:05, just before the incident onset.

contradicting.note: The root cause of failure is explicitly partner-bank-api returning 404 for /v3/collect, which directly links to the upi-gateway routing table configuration change (chg-9824).
The specific targeted failure affecting only @okbank users matches the routing table update precisely.

facts.text: The error rate anomaly for payments-api began at 2026-10-07T14:07:00+00:00, jumping from a baseline of ~0.28% to 7.54% and peaking at 8.71%.
The error rate anomaly for upi-gateway began at 2026-10-07T14:07:00+00:00, jumping from a baseline of ~0.25% to 8.57% and reaching 10.28%.
payments-api logs report UPI collect failures due to upi-gateway error U30 (route failure).
upi-gateway logs report partner-bank-api returning 404 Not Found for collect requests.
A deploy for payments-api v2.15.0 occurred on 2026-10-07 at 14:05:00+00:00.
A configuration change for upi-gateway updating routing handles for @okbank to partner-bank-api /v3/collect occurred on 2026-10-07 at 14:06:00+00:00.

assumptions: The partner-bank-api service does not support /v3/collect or expects a different path for collect requests.

timeline.event: A deploy for payments-api v2.15.0 occurred.
A configuration change for upi-gateway updated routing handles for @okbank to partner-bank-api /v3/collect.
The error rate anomaly for payments-api and upi-gateway began.
upi-gateway logs report partner-bank-api POST /v3/collect returned 404 Not Found for handle 690a8@okbank.
payments-api logs report UPI collect failed due to upi-gateway error U30 (route failure).

recommended_actions.action: Rollback the upi-gateway routing table configuration change to revert @okbank handles back to /v2/collect or the correct active endpoint path.
recommended_actions.rationale: The incident was directly triggered by the configuration change pointing @okbank handles to a non-existent endpoint path (/v3/collect), causing HTTP 404 errors and transaction failures.

recommended_actions.action: Verify partner-bank-api documentation and test endpoint paths before applying future gateway routing updates.
recommended_actions.rationale: Ensuring pre-deployment validation of upstream/third-party API paths prevents mismatch issues.

recommended_actions.action: Implement automated validation checks in the upi-gateway routing configuration pipeline to catch invalid or unverified downstream endpoints.
recommended_actions.rationale: Automation reduces human error during manual or programmatic routing updates.
